Fix https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/12549

### What is changed and how it works?

Set `isPartition` and `physicalTableID` for `PhysicalIndexScan` correctly when the inner child is a single partition of a partitioned table.

issue_context.title: planner: index look join doesn't treat inner table as partition table correctly
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?
If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error.

In `constructInnerIndexScanTask`, it does not set `isPartition` and `physicalTableID` in `PhysicalIndexScan`, so index look join doesn't treat inner table as partition table correctly.

2. What did you expect to see?

index look join treats inner table as partition table correctly.

3. What did you see instead?



4. What version of TiDB are you using (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)?

review_comments: Seems that it is also not set in `(b *PlanBuilder) buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader`, should we fix it in this pr?

It looks like `admin check table` and `admin check index` does not work for partitioned table at all? I didn't find code converting partitioned table to `union all` for these 2 commands, @crazycs520 PTAL
Yes. `admin check table` and `admin check index` call `buildPhysicalIndexLookUpReader` directly. I think they don't set `isPartition`
